entities.summary: David Stone was an American lawyer, judge and politician who served as the 15th Governor of North Carolina. Stone served as U.S. senator from North Carolina before and after his governorship. He also served in the North Carolina convention which ratified the U.S. Constitution, as well as in the state legislature and judge in Bertie County.
